key_insight: MedGame turns static medical cases into interactive, story-driven learning games powered by large language models. Instead of isolated Q&A, it guides learners through a full clinical decision journey.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the gap in medical-education AI systems that only support localized interactions, such as single-turn question answering or feedback, rather than structured, end-to-end case learning.
method: Uses a dual-engine framework to generate executable storytelling games from clinical cases.
A Medical Narrative Designer transforms case-grounded clinical information into a coherent narrative learning flow.
The system organizes the case into decision points so learners actively choose actions and experience consequences within the storyline.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this shows how LLMs can be used beyond chatbots to build interactive, pedagogically structured training tools. It suggests a scalable way to convert domain content into engaging decision-based simulations.
visual_elements: Flow diagram showing static case -> narrative design -> interactive game loop

paper_title: MedGame: Storytelling Gamification Empowered by Large Language Models for Medical Education
paper_authors: Qian Wu, Xinrong Zhou, Zizhan Ma, Kai Chen, Zheyao Gao
